name: Sjnulttjie raststuga-Rävfallsstugan

difficulty.summary: No formal official difficulty grade found. STF presents it as a long 27 km stage. Naturkartan describes the county-boundary-to-Rävfallsstugan terrain as mostly easy/dry path over Björkfjället and along Lisvuojávrrie, followed by descent through rich mountain birch forest. Field reports add exposed upland weather, mosquitoes/midges, bridge-condition history, and a steep, muddy, overgrown descent toward Vindelälven/Rävfallsstugan.

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route page

officialSources.caveat: The same STF page still says the broader Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route has 8 stages/days while the detailed list now shows 9 stages.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Raststuga Sjnulttjie
officialSources.evidence: Official start facility page. Describes Sjnulttjie as a temporary rest shelter/stopover cabin for 8 people with stove, firewood and latrine; overnighting and firewood only for emergencies; no refuse collection.
officialSources.caveat: Start shelter is not normal lodging and should not be imported as reliable water.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Adolfström-länsgränsen, Kungsleden
officialSources.evidence: Official northern route record reaches Sjnulttjie and the county boundary. Describes final approach to the county boundary rising onto Björkfjället above 900 m, with dry easy ground and views.
officialSources.caveat: This is not a section-20-specific page; it covers Adolfström-länsgränsen and raw GPX direction is county boundary toward Adolfström.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Länsgränsen-Rävfallsstugan, Kungsleden
officialSources.evidence: Official southern route record for the county-boundary-to-Rävfallsstugan portion, about 14 km. Describes route over Björkfjället along Lisvuojávrrie, views toward Ammarfjället and Norra Storfjället, descent through rich mountain birch forest and passage by old pasture site Aitenjas.
officialSources.caveat: Needs assembly with Sjnulttjie-to-länsgränsen segment to represent STF stage 8.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Rävfallsstugan Vindelfjällen

officialSources.caveat: Rävfallsstugan is not STF-operated; key booking/payment must be current-checked.

dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.finding: Keep dogs leashed in practice. Swedish law requires strict control 1 Mar-20 Aug in wildlife areas, and Vindelfjällen guidance says loose dogs are perceived as threats by reindeer; reserve rules prohibit disturbing reindeer husbandry.

Do not imply hunting or fishing rights from the hiking route. Tjålmejaure has current bird-hunting caveat; Vindelfjällen/Laisdalen allow hunting/fishing only under applicable law, local rules and permits.

safetyNotes: Long remote stage with no direct public exit at either endpoint.
Severe mosquitoes/midges are repeatedly reported around Sjnulttjie, grass camps, wet forest and water-adjacent stops.
Field reports describe historical bridge work/broken bridges near the forest-line/Rävfalls descent; no official 2026 closure found, so treat as condition history and recheck before import.
Route can be exposed on uplands and windy; one field-reported camp had tent damage in strong wind.
Descent to Vindelälven/Rävfallsstugan can be steep, muddy, overgrown and obstructed by dead birch.
Signs toward Ammarnäs can imply a shorter route that skips Rävfallet; official Kungsleden stage endpoint remains Rävfallsstugan.
Natural water should be treated; carry water from before Sjnulttjie because Sjnulttjie itself is dry/unreliable.
